To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Lorna is coming to Liverpool! 🎉

Lorna Villaruz, your NMC PIN came through today!!! 🎉🙏 I am so, so happy for you—and still cannot believe I get to say this after all these years: you’re coming to Liverpool!

We started this journey together in nursing school in Iloilo, and here we are all these years later. Look at us at our capping ceremony in 1996, with the same hairstyles and the same dreams! 😂 We worked so hard, and I will never forget our dorm days: polishing our white shoes every night… and you borrowing my shoe polish every single time instead of buying your own. Haha! Some things never change.

You went on to work in Riyadh and Dubai for nearly 18 years, and now the next chapter is here. From all the papers and exams to your OSCE in Nottingham—and yes, I did send you a photo of the rain so you knew what you were getting into!—you made it. I’m incredibly proud of you.

I still remember saying goodbye at the airport when I left for the UK in 2004. You were crying and said, “Susunod ako”—“I’ll follow you.” Well, it only took 22 years! 😂 But you’re coming, and that’s what matters. I’ve only been telling you for 20 years, after all!

Your flight is due to land at Manchester on 14 January, around 1pm, and you start at Mersey Bank Hospital on 25 January. Ward 7 medical is lucky to have you. You are the best nurse I know: calm, kind, and so good with patients. They’re going to love you.

And yes, our spare room is ready for your first month—Ben says it’s okay, so you’re stuck with us! We’ll make sure you’re settled in. Just bring a proper coat, because Liverpool wind is no joke! 😂

Welcome to our Filipino family here, Lorna. There’ll be Christmas parties, plenty of food, and Simbang Gabi with us next year. We can’t wait to have you here, make new memories, and show you around our lovely city.

Safe travels, best friend. Liverpool is waiting for you—and so are we! ❤️🎉
